Welcome to the United States of America🇺🇸 Just 1 week until America’s 250th Birthday! 🎉✨ From spectacular fireworks and patriotic celebrations to parades, concerts, festivals and special events across the country, it’s one of the most exciting times to visit the USA❤️🤍💙 Now step into New York City 🗽✨ The city that never sleeps, where iconic landmarks, incredible architecture and unforgettable energy come together around every corner 📍10 Must-Visit Locations in NYC 1️⃣ Statue of Liberty 🗽 The ultimate symbol of freedom and one of America’s most famous landmarks 2️⃣ Central Park 🌳 Escape the city’s hustle with beautiful paths, lakes, and iconic views 3️⃣ Times Square ✨ Bright lights, giant billboards and nonstop energy day and night 4️⃣ Brooklyn Bridge 🌉 Walk across for breathtaking skyline views and unforgettable photos 5️⃣ Empire State Building 🏙️ Experience one of the best panoramic views of New York City 6️⃣ Grand Central Terminal 🚉 A historic masterpiece with one of the world’s most beautiful train halls 7️⃣ The High Line 🌿 An elevated park filled with gardens, art and amazing city views 8️⃣ Rockefeller Center 🌆 Home to the famous observation deck and iconic NYC atmosphere 9️⃣ DUMBO 📸 A charming Brooklyn neighborhood with stunning waterfront and bridge views 🔟 Fifth Avenue 🛍️ The perfect place for iconic architecture, shopping, and classic New York vibes ✅Save this post for your future NYC adventure! 📌❤️Share it with someone who dreams of visiting New York City! 🗽✈️🇺🇸 • • • Follow @alexanewyorkcity for more travel inspiration • • • #newyorkcity #usa #newyork #newyorknewyork #nyc

L’industrie Pizzeria, Little Italy NYC L’industrie pizza definitely lived up to the hype. The burrata slice was so fresh and one of the best pizzas we’ve tried. There was a short line to get in but it moved very quickly and was definitely worth it. They also recommended their fig jam & bacon slice which we did not try but would also recommend trying! Overall this spot was great and the surrounding area in Little Italy was adorable. Definitely give it a try!  Overall Ranking: 8/10🍕 #nyc #lindustrie #littleitaly #nycpizza #bestpizza
